hero.description: Free, donation-based Salsa Cubana for absolute beginners. No partner needed. No experience required. Just show up and dance.

about.label: About
about.p1: Montuno Club is a community-driven Salsa Cubana class for beginners in Munich. We believe that dance should be accessible to everyone — regardless of budget, language, or experience level.
about.p2: Our class happens in a bar, not a studio. The vibe is relaxed. People grab a drink, learn a move, meet someone new, and dance. That is the whole point.

expect.label: What to Expect
expect.step1Text: Walk into Buena Vista Bar on Sunday at 7 PM. Grab a drink if you like. No sign-up stress, no dress code, no awkward waiting.
expect.step2Text: Each week we teach one Salsa Cubana move from scratch. We rotate partners so you practice with different people. No one gets left out.
expect.step3Text: After the lesson, the music stays on. Practice what you learned, try it with different partners, or just hang out and enjoy the vibe.

instructor.label: Your Instructor
instructor.title: Meet
instructor.name: Alex
instructor.p1: Alex has been dancing Salsa Cubana for over 7 years, including training in Cuba where the dance was born. He started Montuno Club because he believes everyone deserves a low-pressure way to start dancing — no expensive studio packages required.
instructor.p2: His teaching style focuses on having fun first. One move per class, lots of repetition with different partners, and a social atmosphere where mistakes are just part of the dance.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.q1: Do I need a dance partner?
faq.a1: No! We rotate partners throughout the class so everyone dances with everyone. Come solo or bring friends — either way works.
faq.a2: Yes. The class is free and always will be. We accept donations to help cover costs, but there is zero pressure. Come as you are.
faq.a3: Comfortable clothes you can move in. Any shoes work — sneakers, dance shoes, whatever feels good. No special gear needed.
faq.q4: I have zero dance experience. Is that okay?
faq.a4: That is exactly who this class is for. We teach one move per session from scratch. Absolute beginners are our people.
faq.q5: What happens in a typical class?
faq.a5: Quick warm-up, learn one new move with partner rotation, then social dancing where you practice what you learned. The whole thing is about 60 minutes.
faq.q6: What language is the class in?
faq.a6: English. Munich has a huge international community and we want everyone to feel welcome regardless of their German level.

location.label: Location
location.description: We dance at Buena Vista Bar in Munich. A social venue with the right energy for learning, meeting people, and having a good time. Not a studio — on purpose.
